Target: Windows x86_64 PE32+, C11, MinGW-w64 POSIX GCC
Host CI image: ubuntu-24.04
Host verification compiler: GCC 13
Windows compiler: x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-posix
Actual compiler version and source hashes are written to build/manifest.json.
Exact compiler package versions will be captured from the first successful CI build.
This foundation build does not claim bit-for-bit binary reproducibility or game support.
